Hi Elena / AP team,

Quick follow-up on INV-4491 (PO 6793) — our records show the invoice is past due as of 2027-05-15. I wanted to lay out a couple of short options so we can get this resolved without delaying your services: 

1) ACH — fastest for us to reconcile; attached is a one-page ACH authorization ("ACH_Authorization_Novatum.docx") and our bank instructions (attachment).
2) Wire — we can accept a wire today; bank details are attached.
3) Credit card — we can accept card via a hosted payment link if AP prefers immediate clearance (note: standard 2.9% card fee applies; we can discuss splitting or absorbing).
4) Split settlement — if PO or approval timing prevents one-shot payment, we can accept a 50/50 split (wire + card/ACH) and will mark the invoice appropriately to reconcile once full amount received.

One additional item: there appears to be a VAT/withholding question on your side — if Novatum needs us to reissue a gross vs net invoice or include a different VAT reference, please let us know so we can send a corrected invoice immediately.

Can you confirm which payment route AP will take by EOD tomorrow (2027-05-20)? If you want us to reissue the invoice with PO 6794 or add the VAT registration number, say the word and we'll get the corrected PDF over.

Attachments: Redwood_Bank_Instructions_2027.pdf, ACH_Authorization_Novatum.docx

Thanks,

Jonas — thanks for the note. A couple quick things from Novatum AP: 

- We have a PO mismatch: our system shows PO 6794 attached to services for May, but the invoice references PO 6793. AP cannot pay until the PO on the invoice matches the PO in our ERP. Can you confirm which PO should be on the invoice?
- We also need supplier VAT / tax ID and a vendor certificate for our records before we can release the second half of any split payment.
- If you send a corrected invoice (PO 6794) and the VAT ID, we can route 50% via wire today and hold the remainder until we receive the VAT docs.

Also, what's your supplier tax ID (TIN) for our remittance file? And one more question — if we push the entire amount to a company credit card (faster), will Redwood honor absorbing the card fee or will Novatum be charged? We can escalate to finance, but I wanted to confirm your position.

Thanks — Elena
